notes.title: Patch 0.38.96
notes.notes:
Currency System Updates
One of the tasks on the short-term roadmap is to make the in game currency (previously called 'Motes') more approachable and more useful. This update is the first attempt at working toward that goal.

Currency Renaming
After quite a bit of deliberation, we've come to the conclusion that "Mote" is a bit too archaic a term for a major part of the game, so a renaming of the currency was in order. This patch renames the currency to "Relic Fragments" as it is both symbolic of a magical object that may have numerous uses, as well as the understanding that they may be useful in number, but not individually.

We wanted to avoid a truly generic currency (gems, gold, crystals, etc) and I think that "Relic Fragments" is unique enough to be interesting while understandable enough to avoid confusion.

Item Upgrade System
Previous to this patch, item re-rolling was based on simply wanting to get the highest value on its ability value range. While it worked, it wasn't particularly exciting or rewarding. Therefore a new Item Upgrade system, based on Diablo's 'Ancient Legendary' system has been implemented.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/7a8397b0e13183f3d383e12e60abe3fe9a96579b.png
All items now have a 10% chance to roll "Hallowed" when they are earned or re-rolled. Hallowed items have a higher value range than normal items with a small overlap (so that the bottom of the Hallowed range is near the top of the Normal range). Re-rolling a hallowed item does not guarantee that the resulting item will still be hallowed.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/3e031daffcfd5a141f8a67797904754c3413f10f.png
Additionally, items have a 0.5% chance to roll "Primordial", which is a 'perfect' item. Primordial items do not have an ability range, and instead have a single value, higher than the maximum value in the hallowed range.

For some items, the primordial value is significantly higher than the maximum hallowed range, and can change how the game is played with the right item.http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/aa053a1dbbc4fedf665c5f59c1ed135175deeb2d.gif
For instance, a Primordial Arcane Vest has the duration of the teleporter last longer than the cooldown, so you can hop from spot to spot around the map.

We hope to do much more with the currency system in the future as well as improve the item system. This is our first step in that direction and you can expect to see more RPG system improvements coming down the line soon :)

notes.title: Beta Patch 0.38.95b
notes.notes:
This update is available on the beta branch for QuiVr. It can be accessed by going to your steam library, right clicking QuiVr, and selecting Properties -> Betas -> and selecting the 'beta -' branch. You can revert this by going to the same place and selecting 'NONE - Opt out of all beta programs'.

Arcade Background Info
A few months ago, we were approached by a Korean Internet Cafe company called Technoblood to see if we were interested in being part of a huge VR push in internet cafe locations in Japan and South Korea. As an early developer in a new content space, we're interested in pursuing almost any opportunity we can, so of course we said yes.

The caveat is that in all of these 7000+ locations, VR will be used without motion controllers (instead using Keyboard and Mouse). Now obviously QuiVr was made from the ground up for use with motion controllers, but games like Luckey's tale have shown that with careful thought controller experiences can be extremely compelling. That understanding, and the fact that 7000+ VR locations is nothing to scoff at, meant that I wanted to give it a shot... bringing us to the present!

Keyboard Controlled Gameplay
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/53c69f41884dc85f924194f6aafa6f77eaa2d95b.png
Using what seems to work in other controller based games, as well as what I've learned from the spectator mode, the new Keyboard system is very different than traditional QuiVr gameplay.

The game is (by default) played in 3rd person, with your view hovering above the player, and the mouse doing all the aiming. This gives the benefits of VR in a way that makes sense for the control scheme. You can play with others in multiplayer with or without motion controllers, and most features of the main game should work, though this is where I want your help.

Testing
7000 locations can add a huge amount to the QuiVr player-base, and should more multiplayer games. However things still need to be tested more thoroughly than I can manage by myself.

In this beta, you can switch into Keyboard mode by pressing [code]Shift + V[/code] This change can only be done in one direction (meaning that you can change into Keyboard mode at any time, but changing back requires a restart or entering/exiting multiplayer). It is also a saved setting, so if you press Shift+V once and come back in, it will start in keyboard mode (Pressing Shift+V while in keyboard mode turns the setting back off, but a reload is required to take effect).

There is a controls UI in the watchtower to help you get accustom to the key mapping, and currently the only missing feature is throwing orbs.

Please give it a try and post bugs/issues in the forums or in the  QuiVr Discord, thanks for your continued help and support :)

A few months ago, we were approached by a Korean Internet Cafe company called Technoblood to see if we were interested in being part of a huge VR push in internet cafe locations in Japan and South Korea. As an early developer in a new content space, we're interested in pursuing almost any opportunity we can, so of course we said yes.

The caveat is that in all of these 7000+ locations, VR will be used without motion controllers (instead using Keyboard and Mouse). Now obviously QuiVr was made from the ground up for use with motion controllers, but games like Luckey's tale have shown that with careful thought controller experiences can be extremely compelling. That understanding, and the fact that 7000+ VR locations is nothing to scoff at, meant that I wanted to give it a shot... bringing us to the present!

Keyboard Controlled Gameplay
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/53c69f41884dc85f924194f6aafa6f77eaa2d95b.png
Using what seems to work in other controller based games, as well as what I've learned from the spectator mode, the new Keyboard system is very different than traditional QuiVr gameplay.

The game is (by default) played in 3rd person, with your view hovering above the player, and the mouse doing all the aiming. This gives the benefits of VR in a way that makes sense for the control scheme. You can play with others in multiplayer with or without motion controllers, and most features of the main game should work, though this is where I want your help.

Testing
7000 locations can add a huge amount to the QuiVr player-base, and should more multiplayer games. However things still need to be tested more thoroughly than I can manage by myself.

In this beta, you can switch into Keyboard mode by pressing [code]Shift + V[/code] This change can only be done in one direction (meaning that you can change into Keyboard mode at any time, but changing back requires a restart or entering/exiting multiplayer). It is also a saved setting, so if you press Shift+V once and come back in, it will start in keyboard mode (Pressing Shift+V while in keyboard mode turns the setting back off, but a reload is required to take effect).

There is a controls UI in the watchtower to help you get accustom to the key mapping, and currently the only missing feature is throwing orbs.

Please give it a try and post bugs/issues in the forums or in the  QuiVr Discord, thanks for your continued help and support :)

notes.title: FT Patch 0.39.1b2
notes.notes:
This update is available on the Feature Testing branch for QuiVr. It can be accessed by going to your steam library, right clicking QuiVr, and selecting Properties -> Betas -> and selecting the 'featuretesting-' branch. You can revert this by going to the same place and selecting 'NONE - Opt out of all beta programs'.

Ground Foliage

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/41885f33d6358e8d06d04022924f1b11c5bc504b.png

Up until now, the canyon has been a barren wasteland save for you and the enemies besieging your gates. This was intentional, as vegetation often looks jagged and artificial (particularly at a distance) in the relatively low resolution of current generation headsets.
However I think it is a problem that can be solved with careful attention to what types of plants are used. By avoiding small details (leaves and thin branches) and instead using large features (big, thick leaves, bulbous shapes, etc) and close grouping (clumps of grass that meld into one at a distance) we can alleviate some of the issues with rendering plants in VR and bring a bit more life into the environments.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/e2de9841cd88cf79aa48a10c796e15fce556a5ac.gif

We can also use them to give more chances for player interaction, creating small but fun events that you can trigger with a well placed arrow.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/9f4e25416d2cd5210d64af803a07bbf4c862c3d1.gif

Some can even have gameplay effects, damaging enemies nearby or activating other effects.

This update adds a significant amount of new flora to the map tiles. All interactions are lightweight (using particle systems instead of physics objects), and the high detail foliage (snow grass) requires Effect Quality to be set at 2 or higher to become active.

Tile Performance
This update also dramatically improves gameplay performance of the tile system by using visibility portals based on the curves of the map. It effectively limits tile visibility to a few in-front and behind your current position, allowing for potentially hundreds of gates and massive maps without significantly affecting performance (other than during map generation).

notes.title: Patch 0.38.93
notes.notes:
This update contains stability and performance improvements as well as initial work on updating the watchtower functionality.

New Spellbook System

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/5ce76bf2452ca8437e00c5377ffcf93ef96d4569.png

UI is always a hard problem in VR, as there are tradeoffs between interaction, complexity, and ease-of-use. Previously the idea of the spellbook sitting on the Watchtower table was to have all the pages change dynamically to have interesting information. Unfortunately that system has some significant limitations including performance issues in creating the page textures at runtime, small page real-estate for packing info, and no in-page animation or interaction.

Therefore I've decided to take a new approach for the spellbook which is a combination of the interactive nature of the book, but also bringing some of the benefits of traditional UI. Opening the spellbook will now also open a UI window floating above the table. You will be able to "Change Page" using the book (though there is only a single page at the moment), but also interact with the UI itself in various ways.

The first page is a global item list, which includes every item that you own as well as all un-owned items (that can be awarded from completing game rounds) with the item name, rarity color, and 3D model of the item.

Other Changes and Fixes

Fixed crash due to experimental Graphics Jobs feature
Minor performance improvements
Updated Personal Bubble system to use dissolve effect
Arrows now dissolve away instead of instantly disappear

notes.title: FT Patch 0.39.1b1
notes.notes:
This update is available on the Feature Testing branch for QuiVr. It can be accessed by going to your steam library, right clicking QuiVr, and selecting Properties -> Betas -> and selecting the 'featuretesting-' branch. You can revert this by going to the same place and selecting 'NONE - Opt out of all beta programs'.

This update implements a few new tiles that benefit from the rocks recently built by the art team, as well as a new canyon environment to explore.

New Snow Tiles
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/f64695a6b541582d2a75854dfe058131c99bd68f.png
Using the newest canyon rock pieces, two new tiles have been added to the snow environment. A long link piece with multiple bridges which enemies will walk down, and a new end-cap which has both some bridges and more interesting geometry.

Desert Environment
As requested many times, we've begun work on new canyon environments to experience and fight in. The first one that we've decided to tackle is the desert. It has a very different feel, but the similarities between sand and snow make it a great way to test the system.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/02ddb9adc1fc12c335f7d52c1aee79bd66a755f2.png

Because of the Tile System, we can transition between sand and snow within the same randomly created level using "Transition Tiles". And geometry itself is actually the least convincing of the transition methods. With the new dynamic sky system and some well placed particle systems, we can make a teleport down the canyon bring you into an completely different ecosystem, all happening in front of your eyes.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/3ad934c43d3cf6933d85a35d1bf604b65248c8be.gif

Environment Mechanics: The 'environment' has two separate chances to be changed (once after the second gate and once after the third gate) but is not guaranteed to change on any particular map. It also can only change to an environment that has a viable transition tile (currently there is a Snow-to-Desert tile, but not a Desert-to-Snow) and the first environment will always start as snowy.

Other Changes

Disabled Graphics Jobs which was causing occasional crashes
Added initial FOVE Headset support (to be discussed in more detail soon)
Minor performance improvements

notes.title: Patch 0.38.92
notes.notes:
Unity 5.6.1 Upgrade
This update was built with Unity 5.6.1 and should result in improved performance and a number of bug/crash fixes.

It also fixed a critical bug that was preventing "Graphics Jobs" from being used. Therefore I've re-enabled Graphics Jobs which should lead to significantly improved CPU performance.

Reversion of new Gate Mechanic
Due to the serious gameplay changes caused by the "Gate Killing" mechanic introduced in the FeatureTesting branch and last beta patch, I've decided to postpone adding the new mechanic to the live branch until some additional testing has been done and feedback collected.

It is very likely that this feature will see significant change (due to either tuning effectiveness or adding player interaction to the system), so I'd like to spend another week or so experimenting with different incarnations of the mechanic to find which one feels the best.

Other Changes/Fixes

New Interactive Objects in the first zone
Fixed Network Physics errors that were causing serious performance issues

Art Update

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/0464c0f5c6f2a0e4f482f02d931cfb58d4b5b3e5.png
Another round of Environment Art has been done with 28 new rocks to populate new map tiles. These focus on bridge and pathway pieces to give enemies more varied ways to enter and traverse the canyon.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/70032935d07e29490e7c85e59b91db19f0cbe9c5.png

Additionally, due to the foresight of the art team and strategic thinking earlier on in development, we have the ability to create tons of new environment pieces with a few simple texture swaps. So I've also been working on new canyon environments, atmospheric effects, and even enemy designs to dramatically increase the game's replayability in the near future.

These assets and features will start to make their way into the FeatureTesting branch soon :)

notes.title: Beta [FT] Patch 0.39.0b9
notes.notes:
This update is available on the Feature Testing branch for QuiVr. It can be accessed by going to your steam library, right clicking QuiVr, and selecting Properties -> Betas -> and selecting the 'featuretesting-' branch. You can revert this by going to the same place and selecting 'NONE - Opt out of all beta programs'.

New Gate Mechanic
This patch adds a new gate mechanic that will dramatically change how QuiVr is played at any significant detail. Please note that this addition is by no means final and is intended for feedback and to see how the game could be played differently.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/31825ed3e86675b891c96eee5cdf59fc4a624ae6.gif

In this update, gates will automatically kill any non-boss enemy after taking damage. This is more in line with traditional "tower defense" games and should allow for a single enemy passing by being ignored without significant consequences.

This change was made due to the game forcing players to remain near the gate after a certain difficulty threshold, and the automatic killing of enemies should allow you greater freedom to move around the canyon without fear of quick gate destruction.

Give it a try and let me know what you think!

Other Changes

Improved enemy hitbox performance using dynamic collider toggling
Fixed "Negative Box Collider" errors in console
Fixed potential crash/freeze due to invalid colliders
Attempted fix for multiplayer arrow orientation
Attempted another fix for Dynamic Teleporters

notes.title: Patch 0.38.8
notes.notes:
This update introduces new visual effects and settings in addition to partially bridging the gap to procedural maps.

Visual Effects
A new slider has been added to the Video Settings called "Effect Quality"http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/d1893015ebf8e066ef8c82893e55fd872d30f924.png
It is a range between 0-3 with 0 being the lowest quality, and 3 being extremely high quality with distortion and dynamic lighting on individual effects. The default is set to "1" and should look much better than the previous default.

Additionally, the HDR Glow setting is now On by default as the new Unity versions allow HDR to work with Forward Rendering. It is therefore much more efficient to use (though performance cost is not negligible).

New Effects
All of the Ability Effects have been updated for a more appealing and rewarding player experience.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/661e16a022aa7ab8d859a9b0e588c6c33748ca24.gif

Additionally, there have been additions to other effects within the game, including Elites, Falling Snow, and Environment Foghttp://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/662f51b1745c9740d5c1528761d5f2daca74b411.png

The rock snow cover has also been updated for much better detail up close, but still limiting visual artifacts at a distance.http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/6e0ea3587e643bd4f11fc9e464487eadfa254d62.png

More Bows
A number of new bows have been added to the data files including a few from the community! Thanks to Pengu and Fliedihi for helping to work out the details of implementing user-created models!
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/e7b659f71a0bb8d6720e7b3c3430474a45f0f22f.png

While these bows are not yet available in game, they are now in the game files and can be rewarded to players without requiring a game update.

Performance Improvements
Thanks to a concerted effort by community members, this update has the largest set of performance improvements since launch. While it is somewhat offset by the new visual effects, you can expect to see significant improvements for both the CPU and GPU performance.

The list of changes that affect performance is extremely long and not most are UI and Networking adjustments, so I'll omit them from the notes.

Art Progress
Finally, we have started progress on the next set of Art assets (working first on new rock formations for more varied enemy paths along the canyon wall) and should have some new and interesting environment structures soon!

Note: This patch also contains all the changes made in Patch 0.38.0

Edit: Another update has been pushed out under the same version number (though different networking version) due to a potential performance destroying bug with networked barrels in the first zone

notes.title: Dev Update - Procedural Map Progress (0.39.0b5)
notes.notes:
It has now been one week since work started on the procedural canyon system, and an incredible amount of progress has been made!

From a small subset of 7 tiles, over a thousand dynamically created maps are possible. Additionally, more layers of randomization have been added in the form teleporter placements and enemy spawns within the tiles will lead to the very real possibility of never playing the same map twice!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/d5c6b5a7a01fbe9a3a2f90c459183ba8149184da.gif

Most of the week was spent creating the underlying infrastructure within the game to handle the dynamic level generation, and only two days were really spent making the current tiles interesting (for reference, the current map took a month to create and playtest to its current state) so the variety and overall feel of the individual tiles will improve over time.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/20e8c367c42bbc45776dc8e852752807867c3e3d.png

You can now play a test version of the Procedural Map game in the Beta branch. I am primarily looking for bug related feedback, as there are over 2,000 new lines of code to handle the map generation and synchronization and I'm sure there are still many issues to tackle (particularly in Multiplayer).

You are, of course, also welcome to give feedback on general impressions of the system and where improvements could be made to make the maps more fun and engaging.

Currently the system is fairly simplistic, where a new map will be generated at the end of a game (after the countdown finishes) as well as when you create/leave a multiplayer game.

In the future, more systems will be put in place for things like the weekly map and special maps with a particular challenge.

Other Additions
In addition to the procedural maps, the Beta introduces a new Effect setting system and HDR Bloom using MSAA thanks to Unity 5.6.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/7f4e905707805526fa2cbf168722d20dea4a55d1.png

Almost every ability has also had their graphical effects updated, and each one has quality settings to push your GPU to it's limit regardless of generation.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/fd6f6423455d823d9e170e5f21cce92db3b2199f.png

More abilities are also coming down the line. There are already three fully functional abilities to be added to your arsenal, though their items are not yet complete or available. So in addition to new maps and environments, you will also be getting a new set of items to earn through play very soon.

notes.title: Patch 0.38.0
notes.notes:
This update brings many of the performance issues back in line and sets the stage for better tournaments and gameplay experiences for the future.

Performance Improvements

Reduced update rate of fading system for improved performance
Added "Soft Particle" toggle in video settings (turn off for better performance)
Improved enemy spawn performance
Recuded physics update rate for improved performance (does not affect arrows)
Dramatically improved statistics tracking performance
Reduced multiplayer CPU usage
Regenerated occlusion culling data lost in Unity 5.6 upgrade
Disabled Elite Auras for performance testing
Re-Implemented x64 requirement after 5.6 removal
Teleporters all now share a single network access point for improved performance


Gamplay and Difficulty Changes
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/a270946b751aef79a4d1062ec57a4b66c86d5b5e.png

Changed combo difficulty multiplier to curve instead of linear formula
Gate 2 and 3 restore requirement now increases by 5 each time it is restored
Gate 1 restore requirement now increases by 1 each time it is restored
Added draw-length slider to settings menu for those with smaller wingspans
Quiver arrow-draw cooldown now disabled in singleplayer
Shooting flying enemy bombs now counts as a normal enemy hit


Spectator Changes

Spectator should now be able to speak in multiplayer using Push-To-Talk
Player nameplates now visible while spectating
Spectators can now move between teleporters using left trigger
Spectators can now move to disabled teleporters
Quick Spectate changed to Bow-Hand Grip+Touchpad
Spectator camera screen size increased 40%
Spectator moving to gates will no longer cause them to close
New gameplay setting panel (Spectator) with Movement Time slider
Added initial spectator camera UI


Other Changes and Fixes

Fixed cave particles when soft-soft particles are turned off
Tutorial button re-enabled in single player
Workshop Uploader now provides useful error codes
Fixed reflections in watch tower


There will also be another announcement later today regarding the immediate future of QuiVr development, so stay tuned for that!

notes.title: Patch 0.37.5
notes.notes:
Update to Unity 5.6
This patch was built with Unity 5.6 and comes with numerous graphics, VR, and performance optimizations. Additionally it lays the groundwork for supporting Linux due to Vulcan support, which we will be actively exploring in the near future.

Unfortunately, as with any engine update there is the chance of unexpected crashes/issues. A new file described below should help fix and crash issues, but please report any unintended graphical/gameplay side effects in the bug reporting forum!

Increased Update Size
The increased size (+120mb) of this update is largely due to the new .pdb file included in the download. This file will turn any crash logs into easily identifiable code-line information to quickly find the cause of crashes for faster fixing.

New Boss
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/55ed3576c7f21ec7136104bf61ece7d5369f292e.png
The Arcane Golem now fights for the enemy hordes and has a random chance to spawn during the boss phase.
It has a permenant slowing orb that surrounds it, slowing any physics-affected objects, but not allied creatures. It is also immune to player-created slowing effects.

To create this new boss, a new immunity system was developed, allowing future enemies to be resistant or immune to various player abilities (fire, electricity, slows, explosions, etc). Expect more variety in the future!

New Command Line Options
4 new command-line options have been added for both Arcade and general use.

+login XXX - Allows input of a Player Profile login name*
+pin 0000 - Allows input of a Player Profile PIN*
+mpjoin 1 - Changed: Now waits for an available game to join (will not host)
+mphost 1 - Creates a public** multiplayer game once fully loaded

* Login and PIN being provided will attempt a login while loading, invalid login will simply fail silently
** Public relating to the current version, so a custom version number will still be unreachable by others.

Difficulty Curve Changes
Due to difficulty (particularly in multiplayer) increasing more quickly than intended during the course of a game, two changes have been made to reduce the speed at which difficulty will increase.

Combo Difficulty boost caped at 25 after reaching difficulty 750
Multiplayer Difficulty 'action-multiplier' reduced based on player number

The multiplayer action-multiplier change will simply reduce the speed at which difficulty increases in a multiplayer game to around the same speed as in a single player game.

The combo change will limit how fast combos can increase difficulty at the later stages of the game, where difficulty could go from 500 to 1000 in a matter of seconds by maintaining a high combo.

Other Changes and Fixes

Armored Enemy hit-box size increased
Player Profiles button should now work correctly
Dissolving enemies no longer block arrows
Target Practice globe disabled while in multiplayer
Tutorial Button disabled while in multiplayer
Gate collision type changed to prevent crash
Gate pieces now dissolve away instead of scaling down over time
Cerberus boss cannon should no longer break combo
Various enemy navigation paths smoothed
Disconnecting while in a game will now fail gracefully
Continue Panel will auto-select "continue" after 60 seconds
Bosses are guaranteed to spawn at 500 and 1000 if enemy req not met
Gate Close volume reduced by 20%
Armored Elite now correctly has Elite Aura effect
Hitting "Armor" objects (ie. Shield) will no longer break combos

notes.title: Patch 0.37.0
notes.notes:
New Boss: Stone Golem

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/bfb3a042c557881497394c7de8df2454d7247e05.png

A new boss has joined the enemy horde! The Stone Golem is a huge creature surrounded by swirling stone shards that provide armor. You will have to break them away to expose the creature within and stop him from crashing through your gates.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/b8779a943e0a5296aaf2ef50fbb9c2c6aa31e14a.png

This is now the second boss available to spawn after each round of enemies. The boss chosen is completely random, so you can have multiple of each in a single game. There has been minimal tuning in terms of health/speed values, so expect slight changes to him over the next few weeks.

Elite Enemy System
Thanks to community suggestions, the Elite enemy system has been completely recreated with a new codebase and design. Where previously elite enemies would all be treated the same (1.5x size increase, 3x health increase) by means of adjusting the base enemy, Elite enemies now are their own enemy type, each tied to a base enemy.

This allows Elite enemies to differ between enemy types and doesn't require any of the same synchronization issues that have been problematic in multiplayer. For instance instead of a health increase, Elite smoker enemies might have a larger smoke radius that was off center (currently, all enemies still follow the general formula 1.5x size increase and 3x health, but the system is there for any number of changes per enemy).

New Graphics Settings

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/c07ed10f88249e365ef452650e502b0be725d0eb.png

Two new sliders have been added to the video settings panel. Texture Quality and Shadow Quality sliders can now be used for significant performance improvements at the cost of graphical quality. Each tick of Texture Quality halves the effective texture sizes used throughout the game, and each tick of Shadow Quality changes the shadow quality preset built into the Unity engine.

Other Changes and Fixes

First gate restoration should no longer reset statistics
Spectator view should correctly align with player rotation
Demo updated to 0.37.0
Leaderboard minimum version set to 0.37.0
Unity warnings should no longer show up in Output_Log for better performance

notes.title: Patch 0.36.7
notes.notes:
Difficulty Changes (General)

Gate Closing - Closing the 2nd and 3rd gate will now increase difficulty by a small amount. The 2nd gate increases the difficulty by 25, and closing the 3rd gate increases the difficulty by 50. This happens each time the gate is closed, including restoring the gate via critical strikes.

Increase over time - The difficulty that passively increases over time has been significantly reduces (by 25%), to rely more on active difficulty boosts such as combos and headshots.

Difficulty Crate - The difficulty crate in the second zone no longer scales with the number of players present (which was a bug). Additionally, it has been scaled up to the current difficulty range of 1-1000. It now grants a starting difficulty of 150 (up from 30).

Enemy Type Threshold - Harder enemy types will now be restricted to much harder difficulties. Before, every enemy was available to spawn at diffuclty 100, this has now been transformed into a 1000 scale (ie. Shield enemies will only start spawning after Difficulty 500). This should lead to a much more manageable difficulty curve.

Difficulty Changes (Curves)

Many of the difficulty scaling systems that previously used linear formulas (ax+b) now use customized curves.

Spawn Rates - Previously, the enemy spawn cooldown was a simple formula of: [code]SpawnCD = BaseSpawnRate / (CurrentDifficulty/80)[/code]This has now been changed to dividing the BaseSpawnRate by a new curve evaluated at the current difficulty, it is more exponential, leading to a lower spawn rate in the beginning of the game, but the same spawn rate near the end.

Enemy Movement Speed - Previously, enemy movement speed was a static formula multiplier to each enemies base speed range:
[code]SpeedMult = 1 + (CurrentDifficulty/600)[/code] Now, each individual enemy has its own speed multiplier curve allowing certain enemies to increase in speed at a different rate than others. It also allows for an exponential increase at higher difficulties and a much slower increase at lower difficulties (0-500) instead of a simple linear increase.

Thrown Orb Mechanic Change
Due to a number of requests and first hand experience with "dropping" orbs, the throwing mechanic for ability orbs has been changes.

Instead of pressing down the touch pad to spawn an orb, and then releasing the touch pad to release the orb, the new mechanic will be to press the touchpad to spawn the orb, and then pulling the trigger to release it.

This new system should feel more comfortable, as you won't risk letting go of the controller, since you actually hold it tighter. And it also should prevent and accidental releases of the orbs as a secondary input is required.

If, however, you have grown accustomed to the previous throwing mechanic, you can swap back to it by using the settings menu, going to Controls, and turning on the "Touchpad Release to Throw Orb" checkbox.

The tutorial voice over has also changed to accommodate this new mechanic.

Performance Improvements (Enemies)

Animation Culling - Previously, enemy animations always ran regardless of their position on screen (even if they were not visible). This is because the damage and audio system was tied to their animations. However, moving that code to a timer based system that uses the length of animation clips instead of current position in the running clip, the game can now spend animation resources only on enemies that are visible on screen. This should be a sizable performance improvement.

Animation Compression - Previously, enemy animations were not modified from their original files. Now however, they use Unity's animation key-frame reduction and animation compression system to reduce the amount of processing required to run the animation.

Performance Improvements (Misc)

Slight performance improvements when loading into multiplayer
Removed Time-Warp physics logging

Other Changes and Fixes

Moved around arrow alters for better zone synergy
Continue panel button activation delay is now enabled for singleplayer
Fixed flying enemy path error
Fixed error about negative collider size
Teleport delay on close reduced to 1 second (down from 3)
Close gate teleport will now be canceled if gate is destroyed
Fixed Workshop Uploader item type (this is the cause of large update size)
Changed Workshop Uploader tag system
Added tutorial line about voice chat in multiplayer

notes.notes:
Difficulty Changes (General)

Gate Closing - Closing the 2nd and 3rd gate will now increase difficulty by a small amount. The 2nd gate increases the difficulty by 25, and closing the 3rd gate increases the difficulty by 50. This happens each time the gate is closed, including restoring the gate via critical strikes.

Increase over time - The difficulty that passively increases over time has been significantly reduces (by 25%), to rely more on active difficulty boosts such as combos and headshots.

Difficulty Crate - The difficulty crate in the second zone no longer scales with the number of players present (which was a bug). Additionally, it has been scaled up to the current difficulty range of 1-1000. It now grants a starting difficulty of 150 (up from 30).

Enemy Type Threshold - Harder enemy types will now be restricted to much harder difficulties. Before, every enemy was available to spawn at diffuclty 100, this has now been transformed into a 1000 scale (ie. Shield enemies will only start spawning after Difficulty 500). This should lead to a much more manageable difficulty curve.

Difficulty Changes (Curves)

Many of the difficulty scaling systems that previously used linear formulas (ax+b) now use customized curves.

Spawn Rates - Previously, the enemy spawn cooldown was a simple formula of: [code]SpawnCD = BaseSpawnRate / (CurrentDifficulty/80)[/code]This has now been changed to dividing the BaseSpawnRate by a new curve evaluated at the current difficulty, it is more exponential, leading to a lower spawn rate in the beginning of the game, but the same spawn rate near the end.

Enemy Movement Speed - Previously, enemy movement speed was a static formula multiplier to each enemies base speed range:
[code]SpeedMult = 1 + (CurrentDifficulty/600)[/code] Now, each individual enemy has its own speed multiplier curve allowing certain enemies to increase in speed at a different rate than others. It also allows for an exponential increase at higher difficulties and a much slower increase at lower difficulties (0-500) instead of a simple linear increase.

Thrown Orb Mechanic Change
Due to a number of requests and first hand experience with "dropping" orbs, the throwing mechanic for ability orbs has been changes.

Instead of pressing down the touch pad to spawn an orb, and then releasing the touch pad to release the orb, the new mechanic will be to press the touchpad to spawn the orb, and then pulling the trigger to release it.

This new system should feel more comfortable, as you won't risk letting go of the controller, since you actually hold it tighter. And it also should prevent and accidental releases of the orbs as a secondary input is required.

If, however, you have grown accustomed to the previous throwing mechanic, you can swap back to it by using the settings menu, going to Controls, and turning on the "Touchpad Release to Throw Orb" checkbox.

The tutorial voice over has also changed to accommodate this new mechanic.

Performance Improvements (Enemies)

Animation Culling - Previously, enemy animations always ran regardless of their position on screen (even if they were not visible). This is because the damage and audio system was tied to their animations. However, moving that code to a timer based system that uses the length of animation clips instead of current position in the running clip, the game can now spend animation resources only on enemies that are visible on screen. This should be a sizable performance improvement.

Animation Compression - Previously, enemy animations were not modified from their original files. Now however, they use Unity's animation key-frame reduction and animation compression system to reduce the amount of processing required to run the animation.

Performance Improvements (Misc)

Slight performance improvements when loading into multiplayer
Removed Time-Warp physics logging

Other Changes and Fixes

Moved around arrow alters for better zone synergy
Continue panel button activation delay is now enabled for singleplayer
Fixed flying enemy path error
Fixed error about negative collider size
Teleport delay on close reduced to 1 second (down from 3)
Close gate teleport will now be canceled if gate is destroyed
Fixed Workshop Uploader item type (this is the cause of large update size)
Changed Workshop Uploader tag system
Added tutorial line about voice chat in multiplayer

Difficulty Changes

This update includes some changes with how difficulty scales in an attempt to remain approachable by new players but still present a challenge to veterans.

Gate Closing - Closing the 2nd and 3rd gate will now increase difficulty by a substantial amount. The 2nd gate increases the difficulty by 50, and closing the 3rd gate increases the difficulty by 150. This happens each time the gate is closed, including restoring the gate via headshots.
This has been done due to watching newer players in the game, which usually stay within the first two gates during their initial runs. This change, in combination with those below, should keep their play areas less stressful, while still maintaining difficulty for those who quickly progress to the end cave.

Difficulty Increase over Time - The difficulty that passively increases over time has been significantly reduces (by 25%), to rely more on active difficulty boosts such as combos and headshots. 
This will hopefully give new players a longer play time before being overrun, while the adjustment above should keep the pace moving for more seasoned players

Difficulty Over Time Curve - The difficulty over time curve was originally built for a max difficulty of 100. This has now been fixed to reflect the current scaling of 1-1000. The curve shape remains the same.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/5b0e4f138ce757c193d378b62e0182eae8cd6d84.png

Difficulty Crate - The difficulty crate in the second zone no longer scales with the number of players present (which was a bug). Additionally, it has been scaled up to the current difficulty range of 1-1000. It now grants a starting difficulty of 250 (up from 30).

notes.title: Patch 0.36.0
notes.notes:
New Update Cycle
After a week at GDC which, while very fun, disturbed the previous update cycle, I think this is the perfect opportunity to adopt a more sustainable release schedule. This will be a bit of a trial run, and if it doesn't work out perfectly that's fine, but I'd like to see how it goes.

Tuesday is will now be Patch Day. While there will still likely be a number of update throughout the week, Tuesday will be the 'Main Branch' patch day, while all other updates will be submitted to the beta branch. Therefore each beta patch will be fairly small, but the Tuesday patch will likely have many more changes, and today is the first of them!

Workshop Integration
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/cc1061e1c686d93a387809ae2d7738f211889113.png
This update sets the stage for workshop integration similar to CS:GO, where players will be able to submit armor skins for curated selection and implementation in the game.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/fd97ab146fec9643241596446427f6aca6469c45.png
There is now a Workshop Uploader folder next to the QuiVr executable with another application that will let you upload items to the workshop, as well as an example package that has all the base outfit items' models and textures for you to use as a base.

The workshop is currently only available to view by owners of the game until I ensure that everything is working correctly.

Multiplayer Difficulty Changes
The multiplayer difficulty curve has been significantly changed in this patch, leading to a much slower ramp up time. This is primarily due to the way that spawn points activate in multiplayer. Enemy spawn points close to a gate will remain inactive until difficulty 200-500 as opposed to 20-50, this should lead to more time fighting enemies at long range during the beginning stages of a round.

Launch Options
Several launch options have been added to the game

Auto-join multiplayer on load: "+mpjoin 1"
Custom multiplayer sessions: "+versionAdd suffix"
Override AFK timer for custom multiplayer sessions: "+overrideAFK 1"

Graphics Jobs
After no serious crash issues were found on the beta branch, an experimental Unity3D setting, Graphics Jobs, have been enabled for QuiVr.

This, in theory, should dramatically increase CPU performance by allowing the Render thread be distributed among multiple threads, allowing parallel graphics processing.

Target Practice
The target practice minigame has been changed from a wave-based mechanic to a timer based mechanic.

Target Range is now timer based (1.5 minutes) instead of wave based
Targets no longer "time out" in range (much nicer for new players)
Target Practice scoreboard updated to new UI style
Arrow based abilities no longer work in Archery Range
Improved Archery Range size (25mb -> 4mb)
Improved Archery Range performance (similar to earlier canyon optimizations)


Other Changes and Fixes

SteamVR plugin updated to version 1.2.1 (up from 1.2.0)
Initial work on Linux support (requires Unity 5.6 in future)
Fixed spawning boss when new player joins while Continue Panel active
Work done on fixing Continue Panel vote discrepancies across network
Enemies per boss increase with difficuty
Enemies per boss multiplayer multiplier increased (0.6 -> 0.75)
Wrist panel in tutorial updated to new UI style
Started work on Vive quick-rotate option
Player mic volume no longer uses spatial audio (still 3D but custom falloff)
Removed upside down teleporter in first area (was confusing new players)
Physical interactions disabled while menus are active (main and continue)
Gate can no longer be closed while a boss is alive

notes.title: Patch 0.35.9b1
notes.notes:
This update is available on the beta branch for QuiVr. It can be accessed by going to your steam library, right clicking QuiVr, and selecting Properties -> Betas -> and selecting the 'beta -' branch. You can revert this by going to the same place and selecting 'NONE - Opt out of all beta programs'.

Back from GDC! Met lots of awesome people (including the co-founder of Unity, David Helgason) and have lots of work for the coming weeks :)

Launch Options
To help with VR arcades as well as more specialized play desires, this patch introduces the first set of game launch options.

Auto-Join multiplayer option: "+mpjoin 1"
This will set the game to automatically join a multiplayer game after loading the main scene. This is particularly useful in conjunction with the option below to immediately load the game into a multiplayer room with friends just by launching the game.

Custom multiplayer session: "+versionAdd suffix"
This will add a suffix (just a string of characters) to the defined network version to create a custom network server in which only players on that version can join. This will be extremely useful for arcades to match players together without worrying about using the private game function or use in-game menus at all. By default, using this launch option will remove the AFK timer (as multiplayer will necessarily be private to that network version).

Override AFK timer for custom session: "+overrideAFK 1"
This option only works if the custom multiplayer session launch option is being used. It will re-enable the AFK timer in multiplayer (and it can not be used to disable the AFK timer in normal multiplayer)

I intend on adding some more of these launch options in the future to make it easier to get to where you want in the game quickly (for instance, loading up a player profile or a specific scene).

Other Changes/Fixes

Player mic volume no longer uses spatial audio (still 3D but custom falloff)
Removed upside down teleporter in first area (was confusing new players)
Physical interactions disabled while menus are active (main and continue)
Gate can no longer be closed while a boss is alive

I can't effectively test Steam launch options without publishing a build, so please give them a go and see if they work correctly for you :)

notes.title: Patch 0.35.8b2
notes.notes:
This update is available on the beta branch for QuiVr. It can be accessed by going to your steam library, right clicking QuiVr, and selecting Properties -> Betas -> and selecting the 'beta -' branch. You can revert this by going to the same place and selecting 'NONE - Opt out of all beta programs'.

Graphics Jobs
A few months ago during the Alpha, I tried using an experimental setting in unity called "Graphics Jobs" to improve performance. Unfortunately it caused a number of crashes for many people and the setting was turned off. 

However, now with a number of Unity updates (5.3 -> 5.4 -> 5.5.0 -> 5.5.1) I think it's a good time to see if the setting is more stable, as it directly helps one of the biggest issues with the game, being CPU bound.

Unity: The Graphics jobs option determines whether Unity uses worker threads to carry out rendering tasks that would otherwise be done on the main thread and, in some cases, the render thread. On platforms where this feature is available [Windows and Colsole], it can deliver a considerable performance boost.

notes.title: Patch 0.35.6
notes.notes:
Scoreboard Versioning

Due to the volitility of difficulty between patches (especially as I try to tune game time and difficulty curves), the high scores have been fluctuating dramatically, and with a 7-day shelf life, they can sometimes be more an indication of luck in logging on right before a bug fix goes through than skill from good shooting.

To remedy this, a new variable has been added to the leader boards, which is the Version Number that the score was achieved. This is then compared to a global database value of "ScoreVersion". As of this patch, the global ScoreVersion is 0.35.6, this means and score achieved before 0.35.6 will not be shown on the scoreboards (though it hasn't been cleared away).

When the 0.35.7+ patches goes live, the 0.35.6 scores will still be shown until there is a patch that dramatically changes the difficulty of the game, at which point the ScoreVersion value will change and the scoreboard will only show scores from that patch on.

Please keep in mind that this is only really neccessary at the moment because of how dramatically the difficulty of the game can change between patches, and a reasonable score in one patch may be almost impossible in another, so keeping older scores visible on the scoreboard can not only make good scores in a harder patch irrelevant compared to the higher scores from earlier, easier patches; but it also has the potential to dissuade new players from trying harder if they see outlandish high scores on the leader-board that they have not chance of achieving themselves.

Other Changes

Shield Bearer weak point more clearly visible
Particle effect when shield is dropped
Dramatically improved Spatial 3D Audio Quality

notes.title: Patch 0.35.5
notes.notes:
Canyon Rock Optimizations
While I think of myself as a programmer, one thing I am not at all proficient at is Shader programming. I generally rely on open source or packaged shaders to get complex effects, one of which is the snow covering on rocks in the game.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/b8a6608461fec9bc4bea1cacd067053665b31a22.png

The way it works is by having a rock texture base that has its own normal maps, tiling, etc. And then having an "Overlay Mask" that screens on another set of texture/normal/tiling (in this case snow).

However, the shader used to do this and get the right effect was really complicated. It had space for 4 different masks all overlaid on top of each other, and we're only using one. The catch is that even if we don't use those extra slots, the GPU still does those calculations, just using 0 for everything (and not changing the final outcome).

So after a bit of trial and error, I was able to cut out all those other slots from the shader code, bringing it down from 188 lines to 102 lines, which is compounded over each frame's rendering and all of the hundreds of rocks in the scene! Hopefully we'll get a nice performance boost out of this change.

Fixes

Fixed issue with invincible singleplayer gates
Fixed frozen boss issue in multiplayer
Fixed issue with Continue panel not appearing in multiplayer
Fixed issue with repeated 'lose' routine in multiplayer

notes.title: Patch 0.35.2
notes.notes:
Dynamic Teleporter Changes

With the continuing issue of ever-present dynamic teleporters in multiplayer, an additional despawn system has been added that will clear all dynamic teleporters on the map during particular events. These events are as follows:

A gate is closed
A gate is destroyed
A gate is rebuilt
The game is ended (win or loss)
You leave a multiplayer game

This should prevent issues of teleporters existing between games.

Additionally, I've made another attempt at fixing the root of the problem (teleporters not correctly timing out in multiplayer) so the addition above should just be a safeguard.

Other Changes

Shield Bearer agent size increased to prevent enemy overlap
Shield Bearer shield size adjusted slightly


I've also begun work on the achievement system for the game, the biggest hurdle remaining is creating progress based achievements that do not rely on Steams statistics API. So far I have not been able to find a way to do it using only QuiVr's database, but I am continuing the search!

notes.title: Patch 0.34.9
notes.notes:
Elite Enemies

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/95ae376bade6807543639fc6147bf01b0ceed2ae.png

To add another layer of difficulty for higher skill players, Elite enemies have been re-introduced from the Alpha.

Elite enemies have 3x the health of normal enemies in addition to being larger and more visible with an 'Elite Aura' that surrounds them. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/fa9496811686510a5b1b93d3aeef75b13ef57eb2.png

They will start appearing at Difficulty 200 and increase in 'Upgrade Chance' using an exponential curve until Difficulty 800 where they reach a cap of 80% Elite.

This will dramatically increase the game difficulty and likely prevent players from reaching scores over 1000.

The difficulty increase is an attempt to lower the average game time for high level players (some over 45 minutes to an hour per game) and promote playing multiple, short rounds instead of a single very long round. However, this curve may be too harsh and will be monitored over the next few days for tweaking.

Other Changes

Duplicate notification now says what item was disenchanted
Notification popup UI updated to new style
Mannequin UI updated to new style

notes.title: Patch 0.34.3
notes.notes:
Time to squash some bugs!

Upgrade to Unity 5.5.1
Due to the high volume of crash reports I recieved over the weekend, I thought it would be a good time to upgrade to the current production version of Unity (5.5.1f1). There were lots of fixes introduced in the 5.5.1 update that could have caused crashes with the previous version (5.5.0f3). 

The important ones are as follows:

Fixed occassional crash calling Destroy() with particle system object in Start()
Fixed occasional crash when using external forces module on particles
Fixed game crashes when new particles are spawned using deprecated Emit method
Fixed OpenVR app built and run with d3d12 crashes on start
Fixed a memory leak when using a canvas and VRFocus is lost

All of those could have caused crashes in the previous Unity 5.5.0 versions and should now be fixed.

Other Fixes

Fixed Dynamic Teleporter despawn in multiplayer
Dynamic teleporters now deactivate correctly on zone change
Fixed ground enemy freeze in place after losing a gate
Fixed overflow error crash on flying enemy path change (15)
Fixed flying enemy loop bug (7)
Fixed enemies teleporting to next path after gate destroyed
Gate restore requirement now correctly scales with player number
Attempted fix for visible teleport circle on retreat (1)
Attempted fix for double teleport placement in multiplayer
Removed multiplayer bow collision


More content additions coming soon, but I wanted to get everything running smoothly before server upgrade tomorrow (to more easily find server related bugs if any arise)

Edit: New update to this patch added to fix gate destruction not occurring correctly in multiplayer

notes.title: Patch 0.34.2
notes.notes:
Crashes
I've been getting a much higher volume of crash reports over the last two days than normal (8 or 9 in two days as opposed to 1 every other week). Most of the reports come from oculus users (though there are a few Vive users as well).

To help find the root cause of the crashing issues, I've uploaded a Beta version of this patch with script debugging enabled. It will have worse performance but log much more information about what is going on within the game.

You can opt into the beta by going to your steam library, right clicking QuiVr, and selecting Properties -> Betas -> and selecting the 'beta -' branch. You can revert this by going to the same place and selecting 'NONE - Opt out of all beta programs'.

Dynamic Teleporters

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/313df9c8468c98c1595259ace59ea76ce8cfa524.png

The Chain Lightning arrow altar in the 2nd area has been replaced with a brand new ability altar. Firing an arrow from this altar into the ground will create a temporary teleporter for a short period of time.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/d7f6044eb0e2a2f86498e31af9cec9ad8213aeb8.png

Anyone may then travel to that teleporter until time runs out, at which point you will be sent back to a nearby, enabled teleporter.

If you place the teleporter in the path of an enemy, you will have to be careful, as enemies will trample you (colliding with one will turn you into a ghost and send you back to another nearby teleporter).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/a8965a5d7540a4fc4e9057f87496f61f78b4fe77.png

You can also shoot the arrows into the surrounding canyon rocks, which will create a teleporter there as well. Due to the magic of the Spirit Anchor and your etherial nature, you will 'stand' on those locations like solid ground, though gravity will still affect your arrows as it always does.

This ability will eventually make its way to an item, but I wanted to have it appear in a more controlled environment here to test it out and ensure that it is working correctly in multiplayer.

Other Changes/Fixes

Quiver alignment is now rotation independent (needed for sideways TPs)
Fixed arrow altar bug on joining room
Arrow hitbox radius reduced 25%
Lowered performance cost of fired arrows
Fixed ricochet force issues

notes.title: Patch 0.34.1
notes.notes:
Server Backend Update
A misunderstanding of AWS settings has lead to a bit of a rushed patch due to me accidentally releasing the public IP address of the data server and making so the current version is unable to get and save data (like user stats or high scores).

So this patch is primarily to update the App's server pointer so that it knows where to go to save/request data.

However, my messing about with AWS is due to a really good thing... the server is getting overloaded with player requests, particularly on the weekend.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/136d35290f6daef0a0b70d7718b978a3b058d1ff.png

Therefore, I need to upgrade the server instance so that it doesn't slow down to a crawl during high traffic.

This will occur Tuesday, February 7th at 11:00PM GMT+5, it will take approximately 2 hours and the server will be unavailable during that time

The IP address change should mean that an update isn't required for the server change now and in the future, so that's nice at least.

Other Changes

Tutorial gloves now always give baseline ability
Updated Stat tracking save rate
Photon Networking update to version 1.80
Photon Voice updated to version 1.80
Added check for server offline and notification (a bit too late huh...)
Demo updated to 0.34.1 as well


Because of the rushed requirement for this update (lots of people were online when the Server IP changed, so the update had to go out immediately), the new Photon version has not been tested much at all. Hopefully it works but expect a few bugs for the next day or so until I can figure it all out.

Also, for those who were online when the server IP change occurred (about 60 people) I'm terribly sorry and I will be putting in some safety precautions to handle something like this in the future.

Please make sure to update or your progress/rewards won't be saved!

notes.title: Patch 0.34.0
notes.notes:
Arcade Mode
The first iteration of Arcade Mode is now fully available. It will let you create and save any number of profiles to your Steam Account. They are treated the exact same as a regular "User Account", so if you go through the steps of saving the profile, Items, Progress, Statistics, etc will all be kept between sessions.
Additionally, you can access the profile from any steam account with QuiVr (if you go over to a friend's or are playing in an actual Arcade).

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/d3edee781ce4daefac7e9dcc04f37462e826cede.png

Creating a new profile is a single step, just go to the Arcade Settings menu and hit "Create New Profile". You'll then be in Arcade Mode and can play immediately.

If you want to save the profile for future use, you have that option as well.

Saving Profiles

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/543d9aaac65525cca5af5ad771ade0c38e15278a.png

You'll be able to change your randomly generated profile name by either randomly generating another one or by typing it in.
You'll also be prompted to enter a 4 digit PIN to keep your profile secure.

Logging Into Profiles

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/1c239900715851f10077189df4227a9fe0e398e7.png

To Log into a profile, you can either select a profile from the list saved locally on your computer, or you can manually type in a username.

After that you'll be prompted for the PIN, successfully entering it will log you into the profile and equip all your armor.

Please note that there are lots of moving parts with this system, so expect some bugs and report them here on the discussion forums or to the Github Issue Tracker.

Other Fixes/Changes

Fixed floating arrow bug
Added reflection probes to all other maps

notes.title: Patch 0.33.4
notes.notes:
Update to Unity 5.5
This update brings QuiVr to Unity Engine version 5.5 (up from 5.4). There are lots of great things that come from this update (Better VR performance, VR-PostFX, Particle System Turbulence, etc), and it keeps us up to date and better positioned to move to 5.6 in a month or two (which has MSAA + HDR rendering!) when it officially releases out of beta.

With a new engine version, there is the potential for a number of unforeseen bugs that stem from incompatibilities with the old code base and the new. Please keep reporting issues here in the discussion forums or in the bug reporting channel of our Discord Server.

Single Pass Stereo Rendering
Along with 5.5 comes our ability to use Single Pass Stereo Rendering. While it was available in 5.4 many effects didn't play nicely with it, and most of those have been fixed in 5.5. Single Pass brings much better GPU performance at the cost of slightly increased CPU performance.

The one effect that has not survived the transition are distortion effects (teleporter and gate close effects), so they have been disabled for the time being.

Arrow Collision Detection
With the 5.5 upgrade, Nvidia PhysX has also experienced an upgrade leading to more accurate physics simulations. This improvement highlighted a significant flaw regarding arrow collision detection.

Now instead of Raycasting (where a line is sent out from the tip of the arrow to check impacts) we are using spherecasting, which means a sphere is projected out from the tip, allowing for the arrow to  have width when checking in front (then falling back to hit-box collision if the cast failed).

This should lead to more accurate and visually-representative physics interactions than were previously seen.

Other Changes/Fixes

Various small rendering optimizations
Multiplayer score saving now works like singleplayer saving
New high scores will refresh username (in case it's changed since last save)
Wrist panel will update while paused
Players joining after boss dies will be presented with continue panel
Implemented fix for disappearing cave fog

notes.title: Patch 0.33.2
notes.notes:
GTX 10X0 Performance
As some may know, I'm going to be getting a NVidia 10 series graphics card tomorrow (for my new dedicated Oculus station), and will be investigating performance issues that I think are due to the card conflicting with the game somehow.

I hope to at least report on my findings in tomorrows patch if I don't get any big fixes completed. So in preparation I did some testing today on my current dev machine (i7 6700k+GTX 980).

Just for reference, here's my profiler data for sitting in an empty multiplayer room having not yet started the game which has caused frame drops for some with a 10 series card.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/e869eeacc3f1237d6bc34efeb8f578059c615bae.png
(Profiling the GPU leads to big performance spikes due to profiling itself, so CPU is profiled instead. CPU Profile can only be as low as the GPU and vice versa, so this profiles GPU indirectly)

You can definitely see that there's something going on since I've had reports of 1080s periodically reprojecting while doing the same thing. Hopefully tomorrow I'll get some hard numbers.

Canyon Performance Improvements
Because of the way the VR headsets work, performance profiling is a bit tricky when trying to optimize. This is because if you're under 90fps you're at 45fps due to how SteamVR controls the rendering.

That means that if the actual GPU usage is 13ms (just 2ms off the requirement for 90fps of 11ms), then the GPU spends 22ms per frame according to the profiler. If I improve the usage to 12ms (an 8% improvement) the GPU will still take 22ms per frame, so I can't actually tell if I improved the performance or not.

That being said, I was able to do some pretty cool stuff with a new setup for occlusion culling and batching.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/f43f35974d5afd2548afb2fa8b500d0e2a1a7557.png

Even on my computer the section above used to drop in performance. I set up the scene with 50 enemies (not visible in the shot) and measured performance with the two different systems.

A conservative estimate would be at minimum a 10% improvement, but it could have been up to a 100% improvement if the framerate was actually 45fps instead of SteamVR bringing it down, so it's hard to tell how much it got better. Either way it's an improvement!

I've added a question for this patch asking if performance noticeably improves. This new system should theoretically allow for more enemies on screen at a time before the framerate threshold is hit.

notes.title: Patch 0.32.7
notes.notes:
Win vs. Lose
With the new continue system that was introduces last week, a lot of decisions were quickly made about the 'gamble' that must be taken when deciding to continue.
Up until now, when choosing to continue, you put your score on the line. While this may be fine for a game like Dark Souls, I don't think it really fits for QuiVr. It's too absolute of a penalty and is not intuitive for new players.

I've changed how the continue-scoring system works to allow a high score to be saved, but in a limited way. 

New System
Each time you kill a boss, a 'current-success' score is saved (the difficulty at which you killed the boss). If you decide to continue and then lose, the last 'success' score will be submitted as the high score. This way there is no real penalty for deciding to continue playing. I think that this is ok however, as it gives you a reason to push yourself instead of a reason to decide that you're done playing.

For new players the system is slightly different. If you lose the final gate before you kill a boss (which will be most people on their first few tries), then your current difficulty will be submitted as the high score.
While this will never put someone on the leaderboard, it will show up on their "Best Score" instead of just showing a 0, which is a great way to make someone think there is a bug in the game and decide to play something else...

I don't think that these changes will have any negative effects on the game, and will have some serious positive ones. 
I'm interested in hearing feedback on the new system though, and will keep an open mind about any potential issues it might cause.

notes.title: Patch 0.32.6
notes.notes:
Difficulty Cap
There was previously a hard cap on enemy difficulty, as there were maximum spawn rates and enemy speeds that could be used to prevent performance issues. However recently it's become clear that players are able to continue past that cap (where difficulty no longer increases) and can potentially play forever.

To combat this, I will be introducing new variables that make the game more difficult once a certain threshold is reached. This update introduces the first of these variables.

After difficulty 500, enemy attack damage increases with a multiplier

The current damage formula is [code]Multiplier = 1 + ((Difficulty-500)/500)[/code]
This means that enemy damage up to 500 will be 1x, 1000 will be 2x, 1500 3x and so on.

Because there is a threshold before this begins, it will not affect new players at all, but better players will have to be more and more cautions of enemies reaching the gate, as they will take it down much more quickly as difficulty increases.

Interested in hearing feedback on it :)

Other Changes
Updated wrist panel to new UI
Added ping display to multiplayer menu
Added music and wind sounds to loading scene

notes.title: Patch 0.32.1
notes.notes:
Reward Bug
I've been trying to track down the issue of games not rewarding correctly, it's hard to find the exact culprit but I've added a new detail that should help.

Currently, there is a safeguard in place to prevent unintended bugs (that previously lead to a few players having millions of motes), where you can only get a reward from a game every 60 seconds. The timer immediately resets in a few circumstances (joining/leaving a multiplayer game) but it may be the cause of the issue due to some unknown bug.

To help find the issue, I've set up the wrist panel title (that shows difficulty) so that it is white when you are eligible for an item, and red when you are not. While it won't really help give rewards, it should show clearly if an issue is present with that system (where the title stays red far longer than 60 seconds into a game).

While playing, try to keep a mental note to check this before deciding to end a game (or at the final stages of losing). This should let me significantly narrow down where I search for the issue.

Other Changes/Fixes

Fixed Lightning Blast damage
Fixed Mannequin item numbering
Fixed multiplayer SteamVR menu disconnecting from multiplayer
Fixed wrist panel difficulty display disappearing over 1000 difficulty
Slightly increased player eye glow
Scaled down mannequin arrow orb trigger
Changed feedback panel UI to new theme


Edit: Updated patch to remove giant standing in the canyon. Whoops...

notes.title: Patch 0.32.0
notes.notes:
27 updates in the 25 days since launch! Thanks to everyone for staying engaged, giving feedback, and helping to improve the game.

New Items

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/7d4af950780b96c3ecdfb9d499dfb70b4627e3aa.png

I've added a new class of item to the game! Now you can earn three different arrows that all have a different ability. The 'Theme' for arrows is "Chance on Miss". They are meant to add a small bonus chance of killing enemies when you miss a target. They're not intended to be relied on, but instead provide a small boost to your overall effectiveness by occasionally making missed shots useful.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25423482/2a2531a7952d434412e877a46ef5950835e2d018.gif

Here's an example arrow effect, which has a chance to put down a bomb trap that lasts for 10 seconds and explodes if an enemy runs through it.

Performance
I found a major bug that survived through the last few patches due to it being silent in the error logs but eating up a ton of CPU performance (> 15% of the entire CPU budget). It's now been fixed ( < 1% CPU budget) and should lead to a nice performance boost across the board.

Additionally, I've turned off Script Debugging which should give back even more performance as the debugging overhead was substantial.

Other Chances

Reverted bow tension click sound change
Lowered pitch of arrow nocking sound
Fixed issue with updating old high scores
Moved pedestal buttons (to prevent accidental pressing)

notes.title: Patch 0.31.7
notes.notes:
Changes and Fixes

Addef FPS counter to main settings page
Added small gate health indicator to wrist panel
Increased hard enemy 'difficulty-requirement' distributions
Fixed freeze on multiplayer disconnect from losing connection
Fixed ability action error
Attempted fix for enemies attacking wrong gate
Attempted fix for incorrect spawn region starting
Attempted another fix for no-reward bug


As soon as we're back on stable ground I'll begin working on the new item system again, but I want to make sure the game is consistently playable before I resume work on that.

New Items
A number of questions have come up about new items. There are more in development and I have some cool ideas for what the bow/arrow abilities will be. However I'm refraining from adding new items to the pool because:

a) There are going to be changes to how you receive new items (not just a notification), and if everyone has all the items it's a bit hard to test out the system.

b) I'd like to not have to do an item wipe. The system is not set up well to handle it, and it's not a pretty lousy feeling to have all your hard earned items erased. A wipe would fix (a) but I think that holding back on new item releases until there is a real reason to add them (ie. new effects that need to be tested with how you interact with items in general) is a much better solution.

notes.title: Patch 0.31.6
notes.notes:
A few issues that have been fixed with today's patch interfered with getting additional info on the no-reward bug, so hopefully will be working on that again tomorrow.

Multiplayer AFK
In the alpha, there was a system in place that would remove AFK players from multiplayer games after 2 minutes of inactivity. At some point during the transition, the system broke. Additionally, there was always an issue of the SteamVR menu stopping game code execution, so the timer couldn't increase while the menu was up.

This update fixes both of those issues. The AFK timer has been fixed so that it will correctly count up to 2 minutes of inactivity, and then disconnect from the room. And the SteamVR Menu will no longer pause while in a Multiplayer game.

Changes/Fixes

Fixed Outfit-Activator error
Fixed Glove Orbs sticking to hand
Attempted fix for immortal boss
SteamVR menu now slows to 1% speed instead of 0%
Enemies-per-boss increase slowly as difficulty increases (~10 per 100)
Attempted another fix for boss getting stuck at gates
Built navigation 'drop-zones' to help fix stuck enemies
Attempted fix for teleporter enemies getting stuck
Fixed normal enemies taking boss paths
